_note: Assembled from product/recent-deals/inputs/ (team files finalized 2026-10-26). Every graded input is dated on or before announced_on.

replacement_cost.missing: No price was public at announcement (Oct 1, 2026). The $241.4M hotel-portion figure comes from a deed recorded Oct 2, after the announcement, so price per key isn't graded.

spread.missing: No trailing-12-month cap rate or NOI disclosed, and no price at announcement.

supply.missing: Only an under-construction share is public (Phoenix metro 5.7%), a subset of the total pipeline; no single source gave the total pipeline share by Oct 1, 2026.

demand.source_label: City of Scottsdale monthly tax collection report, March 2026 (archived May 19, 2026)
demand.fallback_reason: The city overwrites a single-month PDF each month, so a trailing-12-month series can't be built from figures provably public by the announcement.
demand.period: City of Scottsdale bed tax, fiscal year to date Jul 2025 to Mar 2026 vs prior; $25,401,992 vs $24,458,616

debt_context.summary: Acquisition announced by the buyer, a tribal investment authority; no distress, lender action or relationship between the parties public by Oct 1, 2026. The hotel is CMBS collateral (SHR 2024-LXRY); its release amount isn't public.
